suppress.notes:
CPE collision. CVE-2026-33504 is a SQL injection in the Ory Hydra server (the Go service, fixed in Hydra v26.2.0). The Java client SDK sh.ory.hydra:hydra-client is a generated HTTP client with no SQL code, so it cannot be affected.
Tracking the dep itself for eventual removal — integrate_with_hydra defaults to false and TESOBE does not deploy with Hydra enabled.
